title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00131 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:45: Purged lubricator with n2.
00:45 - 00:50: Held toolbox talk prior to l/d BHA
00:50 - 01:30: Broke lubricator and l/d BHA on deck. Checked and verified setting tool OK.
01:30 - 02:00: Schlumberger tested cable head.
02:00 - 02:10: Held toolbox talk prior to m/u BHA guns)
02:10 - 02:50: Lifted BHA up to drill deck using rig crane.
02:50 - 04:25: M/u BHA for run guns). Leak tested QTS to 20/160 bar 5/10 min.
04:25 - 04:30: Opened SV and HMV. WHP 0 bar.
04:30 - 04:55: RIH w/ run guns), 4 1/2" od guns to 600 m.
04:55 - 05:05: Schlumberger powered up and checked tools at 600 m
05:05 - 06:15: Continued to RIH with BHA from 600 m to 3550 m. Took PUW every 500 m depth PUW(LBS) 500 2250 1000 2850 1500 3540 2000 4050 2500 4800 3000 5400 3500 6100 actual friction factor 0,18
06:15 - 06:50: Performed 4 correlation passes interval 3460 m to 3550 m.
06:50 - 07:30: P/u and placed bottom shot at 3510 m and top shot at 3501 m. Bled off WHP to 3 bar, took some time to bleed off.
07:30 - 07:35: Perforated well interval 3501-3510 m. Lost 170 lbs on tension. WHP before/after 3/12,2 bar a-annulus before/after 12,8/12,8 bar, b-annulus before after 7,2/7,2 bar
07:35 - 07:45: Logged CCL up from shooting depth to 3460m.
07:45 - 09:55: Continued POOH to surface. WHP 11,9 bar.
09:55 - 10:25: Closed HMV and SV. Inflow tested SV by pressuring up XMT to 200 bar.
10:25 - 11:05: Purged lubricator with n2.
11:05 - 11:20: Held toolbox talk prior to l/d perforation BHA.
11:20 - 12:30: Broke lubricator. L/d BHA on deck. Confirmed all shots fired.
12:30 - 14:40: Schlumberger tested tools for next run with BHA guns).
14:40 - 14:50: Held toolbox talk prior to r/u BHA guns)
14:50 - 16:20: M/u BHA for run guns). Stabbed lubricator and leak tested QTS to 20/160 bar 5/10 min.
16:20 - 16:50: Equalized and opened SV and HMV. WHP 13,5 bar.
16:50 - 17:15: RIH w/ run guns), 4 1/2" od guns from surface to 600 m.
17:15 - 17:25: Schlumberger powered up and checked tools at 600 m
